description:
CMS files and HTTP functions (backend code): read, edit, version, run. Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- get_http_function: Get the main HTTP function file.
- get_http_function_snippet: Read specific function(s) by name.
- edit_http_function: Edit the HTTP function file by function name — best for targeted changes (fix a bug, rename, add one function).
- update_http_function: Write the FULL HTTP function file content.
- create_cms_file: Create a new CMS file.
- update_cms_file: Update the code content of an existing CMS file
- save_file_version: Save a version snapshot of a CMS file for rollback
- restore_file_version: Roll a CMS file back to a saved version in one step: reads the version's content and writes it back to the file.
- run_function: Run a deployed HTTP function.

code.description: New function code (for replace_function and add) or new import block (for update_imports) [edit_http_function]

content.description: Full JS code content [update_http_function, create_cms_file, update_cms_file, save_file_version]

function_name.description: Target function name (for replace_function and remove) [edit_http_function, run_function]

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

version_id.description: Which version to restore (api_find 'file versions' → api_get). [restore_file_version]

name: cms_function
